## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Generic chatbot demos; no evidence of working with external users

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Hardware / accelerator:** application and deployment work
- **Research craft:** not expected

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01): services channels [T0-11]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** Lab-tier hiring bar on top of the AI Engineer stack; backend (~6 months) and PhD (~8 months) routes [D · T0-06].
- **Proof to show:** A customer-facing reference implementation with evals and a published write-up; the AI Engineer T2–T3 portfolio.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** applied AI, LLM, customers, evals, deployment, solutions, safety.
